audit_summary.overall_risk: CRITICAL - Multiple severe vulnerabilities present in original code

vulnerabilities_detailed.name: Hardcoded API Key
vulnerabilities_detailed.description: AWS API key hardcoded in source code exposing sensitive credentials
vulnerabilities_detailed.impact: Unauthorized API access, account compromise, data theft

vulnerabilities_detailed.name: SQL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities_detailed.description: User input directly concatenated into SQL queries via .format()
vulnerabilities_detailed.impact: Database compromise, unauthorized data access, data manipulation

vulnerabilities_detailed.name: Insecure Deserialization (RCE)
vulnerabilities_detailed.description: Unsafe pickle.loads() on untrusted user data enables remote code execution
vulnerabilities_detailed.impact: Remote code execution, complete system compromise, arbitrary command execution

vulnerabilities_detailed.name: Command Injection
vulnerabilities_detailed.description: User input directly passed to os.system() enabling command injection
vulnerabilities_detailed.impact: Remote code execution, arbitrary command execution, system compromise

vulnerabilities_detailed.name: Template Injection (SSTI)
vulnerabilities_detailed.description: User input inserted into Jinja2 template via render_template_string()
vulnerabilities_detailed.impact: Template injection attacks, potential code execution via Jinja2 expressions

vulnerabilities_detailed.name: Hardcoded Plain Text Passwords
vulnerabilities_detailed.description: User passwords stored as plain text in source code
vulnerabilities_detailed.impact: Credential exposure, unauthorized account access, password compromise

vulnerabilities_detailed.name: Weak Authentication
vulnerabilities_detailed.description: Direct string comparison for password verification without timing attack protection
vulnerabilities_detailed.impact: Timing attacks, weak password verification, no session management

vulnerabilities_detailed.name: Debug Mode Enabled
vulnerabilities_detailed.description: Flask debug mode hardcoded to True, exposing sensitive information
vulnerabilities_detailed.impact: Information disclosure, error stack traces leaking data, debugger access

vulnerabilities_detailed.name: Missing Error Handling
vulnerabilities_detailed.description: No structured error handling or logging for security events
vulnerabilities_detailed.impact: Information disclosure via errors, unable to detect attacks, poor incident response
